name: tailscale
title: Tailscale
description: Joins the printer to your Tailscale mesh network (tailnet), so you can reach Fluidd/Mainsail, the camera, and SSH from anywhere without opening a port on your router. Bring your own account: generate an auth key at login.tailscale.com/admin/settings/keys, then paste it below. The printer authorizes itself the way any Tailscale device does; it appears in your tailnet's device list like a laptop or phone. Bespok3d hosts no coordination service and never sees your auth key or traffic. Runs tailscaled as a managed service on top of the tun-module base (a real /dev/net/tun the tailscale0 network interface needs).
tagline: Reach your printer from anywhere over your Tailscale network.

variables.name: TS_AUTHKEY
variables.description: An auth key from your tailnet's admin console (login.tailscale.com/admin/settings/keys), starting with tskey-auth-.

config.label: Tailscale auth key
config.hint: From your tailnet's admin console (login.tailscale.com/admin/settings/keys). Bring your own account; Bespok3d hosts nothing. A reusable key lets you reinstall without generating a new one each time.
